orig.il: and they shall be my people
thee, and thou shalt be built

orig.gloss: and/ they will put [them] to use

orig.il: ye, and let us go up
and her that travaileth with child
them: I will cause them to walk

orig.gloss: and/ they will cry out for joy
and/ I will make glad/ them

orig.il: thou me, and I shall be turned

orig.gloss: I will have compassion on/ him

orig.il: How long wilt thou go about
thereof, when I shall bring again
itself, and in all the cities
like as I have watched over
and they shall be my people
for all that they have done
over against it upon the hill
it shall not be plucked up
